scope: Four source-confirmed workflow and mounted-discovery gaps; not an exhaustive audit of 670 cognitive methods

gaps.repair: Both admitted workflow entry points call the same runner under verified principal/session/genesis; each step receives canonical admission again

Bounded lifetime capacity reservation precedes durable acceptance; detached admission preserves ownership across requester disconnect. Initial persistence and lifecycle transitions serialize. Persistence failure closes ownership, rejects later controls and prevents further dispatch

Typed pause/resume/cancel results, exact session-owned execution selection, optional execution_id for ambiguity, cooperative pause/cancel after in-flight settlement; no backend undo or automatic replay
Read existing mounted schema.json/object.hash with identity/catalog verification; retain declarations only; load addressed state freshly; do not fabricate missing source-schema provenance

contracts.authority: Plugin-owned Rust schemas; cognitive workflow declarations reuse workflows owner types

rw_and_memory.authority: Private Cozo execution records in the existing isolated episode store; terminal episodes use existing private SHM publication
rw_and_memory.lifetime_coordination: At most 64 admitted executions, two concurrently dispatched steps; paused runs release worker capacity
rw_and_memory.bounds: 1..32 explicit executable steps, 16 KiB JSON args per step, 128 KiB initial execution document, 256 KiB durable document, 200-row bounded history or exact scoped execution lookup
rw_and_memory.policy: Exact verified principal/session/genesis; existing read/write grants unchanged; per-step canonical admission; workflow audit arguments receive private treatment

limitations: Progress is queried through the scoped workflow method; no lifecycle watch or new SHM streaming surface is advertised
Unknown backend outcomes and lost ownership are not replayed; cancellation does not undo completed or in-flight effects
Historical unscoped workflow journal receipts remain untouched and are not migrated or executed
Named workflow templates require explicit executable params.steps; decorative/default steps are no longer accepted as successful empty runs
Functional and restart behavior remains unverified until the separately assigned testing agent runs its checks
